basic_info.description: Expansion Potential! Welcome home to this charming top-floor Edwardian condo in the very desirable Lake St. Corridor! This lovely 2BR, 1.5BA home is move-in ready and brimming with character throughout- gleaming hardwood floors, original wainscotting and coved ceilings. The inviting living room is light-filled and spacious with a cozy fireplace with an adjacent office or possible 3rd bedroom. The eat-kitchen offers a perfect blend of modern convenience and timeless style with all the modern updates. Step outside to enjoy a serene, beautifully landscaped garden complete with a fountain, fire pit and dining area- your own private retreat in the heart of the city. Plus,  the spacious attic is screaming "EXPANSION!" It currently provides tons of extra storage space, but but HOA has permitted unit 4132 to develop it into living space. Nestled in the sought-after Lake Street District, this pristine condo is ideally located for both tranquility and convenience. Just a short distance to Park Presidio, the Presidio Golf Course, and Mountain Lake, plus easy access to vibrant local shops, cafes, and specialty grocery stores in the nearby Laurel Heights shopping village. With a Walk Score of 91, everything you need is within reach, and public transportation is just a block away.
